name: stickRepeatMs
meaning: ms since the analog step was recomputed (150 ms period)

name: dpadStep
meaning: d-pad aim step per frame, 5 rising by 2 every 150 ms up to 25

name: lastPos
meaning: position used to shift the activation box in MoveTo/Translate

name: muzzlePos
meaning: basePos raised by 80: aim-camera eye, barrel position, ball home/respawn

name: aim
meaning: current (pitch, yaw, roll) = defaultAim + aimOffset; replaced by the camera forward vector on fire and passed to the ball as launchDir

name: aimOffset
meaning: player offsets (pitch clamp -vertLimit..40, yaw +-horzLimit); kept across Reset

name: pipes
meaning: Pipe (96) objects; each gets msg 0x66 on fire

name: muzzlePosCopy
meaning: copy of muzzlePos written by MoveTo/Translate; no reader found

name: barrel
meaning: PROPERTY CANONDUMMY: the CanonDummy barrel model, rotated by ApplyAim

name: ball
meaning: PROPERTY CANNONBALL: the CannonBall driven by messages
